blocks.x: How Achala Twinverse is put together: the ingestion fabric, the twin core and the actuation controls that keep physical systems safe.
Structurally Achala Twinverse is planes, not layers, workload, decision and evidence run in parallel behind one governed API, and each crossing is logged with policy version and owner.

Runtime dependencies: OPC UA, MQTT Sparkplug B, LoRaWAN/NB-IoT, KubeEdge/K3s, CMMS/MES adapters. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Achala Twinverse follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
